newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly easier on Monday, with naphtha retreating in line with crude.
Gasoline remained depressed by weaker crude and products futures. A closed arbitrage to the U.S. and the tail off in pre-U.K. budget demand dulled cargo trade.
Naphtha eased with crude, but the market was better balanced with all of the Nov Algerian cargoes placed.
Gas oil premiums were talked unchanged to slightly easier in thin trade, with outright prices easing $2 in line with futures.
Fuel oil fell $2/3 per tonne on some distressed offers, but the arbitrage from Europe to the United States widened further.
